title: Social Networks as Information Conduits for Online Credit Supply and Demand
authors: Linda Allen; Lin Peng; Yu Shan
eligible_reason: No binary treatment. All main-table regressions are IV (ivreghdfe) of 3-digit-ZIP-level LendingClub demand/supply/performance outcomes on continuous social-proximity measures (SPLCB, SPD, SPC, SPMisc) instrumented by SCI-weighted disaster exposure or misconduct, with zip3 and year (or year-month) FE, clustered by zip3 (dofiles/9-3 to 9-11). No adoption timing, no DiD.
design_notes: ZIP3 x month (demand) and ZIP3 x year (supply, performance) panels built from LendingClub, Facebook SCI, FDIC SOD, ACS, FEMA, SEC IAPD. Table 1a/2: ivreghdfe focaldemand `controls' (l1_splcbp_dis100_apl = l1_spdisaster_dis100), absorb(zip3_id ym) cluster(zip3_id). Tables 3-7: ivreghdfe supply/performance outcomes with absorb(zip3_id year), interactions with disadvantage index.
data_files: data/demand_main.dta, demand_cs.dta, supply_main.dta, supply_cs.dta, performance_main.dta, performance_cs.dta, areadefault.dta, applications_originations.csv (final analysis files)
data_raw/, data_intermediate/ (large raw inputs not redistributed per README)
software_detail: Stata (ivreghdfe, reghdfe) with R for Figure 1 maps
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). The ft_borusyak flag reflects shift-share/IV references, not DiD imputation.
